content: Bits 7  6 of Byte 0 of the FrameIDFlexRay shall contain the channel assignment of the reported FlexRay frame. Bit 7 shall be set to 1 if the reported FlexRay frame is available on channel B of the FlexRay controller, otherwise it shall be set to 0 . Bit 6 shall be set to 1 if the reported FlexRay frame is available on channel A of the FlexRay controller, otherwise it shall be set to 0 . A reported FlexRay frame is either assigned exclusively to channel A or B or to both channels.
